verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence pack documents an Ollama feature for creating custom, task-specific assistants, such as per-model system prompts or persona configuration. The material is adjacent only: Ollama connects to external agents and to OpenClaw, a separate assistant tool, and one community user swaps between different models for different bot features. Third-party integrations and user-side arrangements earn no credit toward this story.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can create specialized custom assistants configured for specific tasks
